deck_title: Hertz-Boussinesq F^(2/3) elastic contact footprint vs naive linear-force area bloat rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Heinrich Hertz (1882) & Joseph Boussinesq (1885) non-adhesive elastic sphere contact mechanics (contact radius a = (3FR/(4E*))^(1/3), contact patch area A_Hertz = A_0 * (F/F_0)^(2/3) = A_0 * (1+u)^2, and mean contact pressure p_mean = p_0 * (F/F_0)^(1/3) = p_0 * (1+u), locking A/A_Hertz = 1.0000x across all 17 load stations u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive constant-pressure linear-spring contact area (A_naive = F/p_0 = A_0 * (1+u)^3, which bloats footprint area by 1+u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-ring Boussinesq hemispherical pressure quadrature.
